name: Aussie Dollar Token
oneLiner: AUDX is TAU Pty Ltd's centralized Australian dollar stablecoin, designed for 1:1 AUD redemption and backed by AUD cash and government-backed instruments.
collateral: Australian-dollar cash and government-backed instruments held 1:1 for AUDX by TAU Pty Ltd trading as AUDX Token
pegMechanism: Issuer-managed mint and redemption path targeting 1 AUDX = 1 AUD through fully backed Australian-dollar reserves

blacklistabilityReview.evidence: Explicit Possible retained: reviewed metadata indicates direct token, vault, issuer, pause, proxy, or admin-control uncertainty, but available registry sources do not prove an active holder-balance blacklist path.

mintAuthority.summary: AUDX is issued by TAU Pty Ltd (trading as AUDX Token); minting and 1:1 AUD redemption run through the issuer's centralized backend against AUD cash and government-backed instruments held in reserve.

controls.label: TAU Pty Ltd issuance backend
controls.evidence: Issuer-managed mint/redeem: TAU Pty Ltd creates AUDX supply against custodied AUD reserves targeting 1 AUDX = 1 AUD; no permissionless or user-collateralized mint route is described.

review.evidence: AUDX issuer materials describe a single-entity issuer-managed mint and redemption path against fully backed AUD reserves; transparency disclosure is limited but the model is a centralized fiat issuer.
review.sourceFreeRationale: Issuer model established from project materials; on-chain token owner/minter admins on Ethereum, Polygon, and Conflux not independently resolved, and issuer transparency is limited.
unresolvedQuestions: Resolve the on-chain token owner/minter admin on Ethereum, Polygon, and Conflux before raising confidence.
